title: Three independent axes; line 1 is where the energy goes (2026-10-22)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So, my theory is that we can judge a decision on the three axes. But each is independent.
The archetypes are just those that prioritise a specific type of decision.

These will not define anything about the domain, but the classification may overlap with the others, and the synthetic process makes it mappable.



Line 1, the bottom line of the trigram. 

Every decision has a choice to act, to apply energy outward apply will on the world, or to allow energy inward, to change the inner reality or system itself.
